Instruction account info initialization and lamport accumulation helpers.

# Purpose
This C file implements helper functions for `fd_instr_info_t`, which stores instruction-level account and data information for a transaction execution context. The function [`fd_instr_info_init_from_txn_instr`](<#fd_instr_info_init_from_txn_instr>) reads a transaction instruction from `fd_exec_txn_ctx_t`, copies the program ID, data pointer, and account count into `instr`, and then builds the per-account instruction state by calling `fd_instr_info_setup_instr_account`. It also tracks seen account indexes with `acc_idx_seen` so the instruction can mark duplicate accounts and set writable and signer flags from the transaction context.

The file also provides lamport accounting helpers. [`fd_instr_info_accumulate_starting_lamports`](<#fd_instr_info_accumulate_starting_lamports>) adds the starting lamports for one non-duplicate account into the instruction total, and [`fd_instr_info_sum_account_lamports`](<#fd_instr_info_sum_account_lamports>) computes the total lamports across all unique instruction accounts. That sum uses `fd_uwide_inc` to handle 128-bit style addition with high and low words, and it returns `FD_EXECUTOR_INSTR_ERR_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW` if the total wraps.
